scenicChapters.title: Bright → Mount Hotham
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 79 km. 1845 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Mount Hotham → Omeo
scenicChapters.narrative: 108 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

great-alpine-road-wangaratta-omeo.story: A one-way ride of 363 km, Wangaratta to the finish - roughly 4 h 59 in the saddle. On the way it passes Bright and Mount Hotham. The highest point is about 1,850 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Czech South Moravian Wine Route
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 51 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

vienna-eastern-alps-neusiedler-see-easy-.story: A 511 km loop that starts and ends near Petronell-Carnuntum, about 9 h 27 of riding. It goes by way of Hustopeče, near Hodonice, near Wilhelmsburg and Perchtoldsdorf. near Sopron is the high point. It crosses Austria, Czechia and Hungary - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules.
